title: Custom Football Player Holding Ball Collage Comforter with Football Helmet
description:
Bring the thrilling spirit of the game straight to your bedroom with this custom sports-themed bedding set from Jeminise. Great for football lovers, players, and fans alike, this bedding provides a super soft feel and a layer of breathable warmth, making it the perfect personal addition or a thoughtful gift for any occasion.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with options for custom text inputs, allowing you to add a name and jersey number for a truly unique look.
  • Two Bedding Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover designed to be paired with an insert, or a cozy, thicker comforter that provides all-in-one warmth.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for any bedroom setup, available in Twin, Full, Queen, and King sizes.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick-drying, and simple to maintain for long-lasting durability.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Amazing Football Squad
Theme Football
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
